faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.helpBody: We're here to help. Reach out anytime and our team will get back to you.

q1.q: What kinds of machines are in the catalog?
q1.a: The catalog covers excavators, lifting and handling equipment, road rollers and diesel generator sets.

q2.q: How do I request a quote?
q2.a: Open a product page and choose Request a quote, or use the contact form and tell us which model interests you.

q3.a: Use the catalog filters and sorting to line up models by category, engine power or weight, then open each page for the full specifications.

q4.q: Which languages does the site support?
q4.a: The interface is available in Persian, English, Arabic and Russian, and switches layout direction automatically.

q5.a: Specifications shown here are sample content for this showcase. Confirm details with our team before ordering.
